Mambourin Minis Kids Club

Free weekly fun for kids and families — every Friday at Mambourin Marketplace.

About the Event

Mambourin Minis Kids Club is our beloved free weekly program designed to give children an enriching, joyful morning while helping families connect with their local community.

Each Friday morning, we host a range of age-appropriate activities curated to stimulate young minds and spark creativity. From guided sensory play stations and interactive story time sessions to hands-on craft activities and live music sing-alongs — there's something for every little one.

Our warm, welcoming environment makes it easy for parents, grandparents and carers to relax and socialise while the kids have a blast. No booking required — simply arrive, join in and enjoy.

What's Included Each Week

🧩
Sensory Play Tactile activities designed to engage and develop little senses
📚
Story Time Engaging read-aloud sessions with themes that change weekly
🎨
Crafts & Making Hands-on creative projects kids can take home
🎵
Music & Movement Live music, songs and movement activities for all ages

What to Bring

  • Comfortable clothes (activities can get messy!)
  • A water bottle for your little one
  • A snack if needed
  • An apron or smock for craft activities (optional)
  • A pram or stroller is welcome — we have plenty of space

Event Details

  • When: Every Friday
  • Time: 10:00am – 11:30am
  • Cost: Free
  • Booking: No booking required
  • Ages: All ages welcome
  • Location: Centre court, Mambourin Marketplace

Getting Here

36 Delama Boulevard, Mambourin VIC 3024

  • Free on-site parking available
  • Pram and wheelchair accessible
  • Easy access from Princes Freeway via Black Forest Road
